regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-horse leadership concentrated in Banks (rank 1, crowded, high durability 0.73) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, crowded, durability 0.60), with the rotation margin razor-thin (0.01) and no directional handoff (directional=false). Only 4 of 22 themes pass the absolute-trend gate (eligible), breadth of rotation is narrow (0.18), and the backtest explicitly flags that this market's trend gate did not hold historically (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), so the only validated edge—drawdown control—does not apply here. Given track_record dir_accuracy of 0.377 against a coin-flip baseline, I default to low conviction and minimal theses.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Pharma & CXO (challenger, score 0.988) closes the 0.01 margin to Banks and the rotation flag flips to directional=true. The observable condition that would retire this watch: Pharma's durability_bar rises above Banks' AND breadth_of_rotation.frac climbs above 0.30, confirming a genuine broadening rather than a two-horse tie.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks lead the ranks (score 0.998) with the highest durability bar (0.73) and strong breadth (0.889), suggesting the current leadership is broad-based rather than a thin single-name spike. The absolute-trend gate confirms eligibility (eligible=true), meaning the theme is in an absolute uptrend. Crowding (z=1.78, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade—and since this market's gate is mean-reverting, I lean directionally but hold low conviction given the weak track record.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z=1.78) and in a mean-reverting tape where the trend gate historically whipsaws; the leading theme may be the last to complete a mean-reversion reversal, and attention spikes on the leader often mark local tops.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS breaks below its 20-day moving average and the theme loses its eligible=true status on the next detector snapshot

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is a near-tied challenger (score 0.988, rank 2) with eligible=true and a still-strong durability bar (0.60). The rotation margin versus the leader is only 0.01 and directional=false, so this is a co-leadership rather than a confirmed handoff—therefore I lean with it rather than calling a rotation. Crowding (z=1.59, crowded=true) is again a size-down caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: This theme is nearly as crowded as Banks with lower breadth (0.643 vs 0.889), and in a mean-reverting market with no validated gate edge, the second-ranked crowded theme is equally vulnerable to a sharp mean-reversion drawdown without the broad participation cushion.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ underperforms 512800.SS by more than 3% over the next 10 trading days and Pharma's durability_bar drops below 0.45

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics ranks 3rd (score 0.682) and shows a trend Hurst tag, but it is ineligible=false under the absolute-trend gate, meaning the theme has not confirmed an absolute uptrend. Breadth is extremely thin (0.059), indicating leadership is concentrated in very few names. The detector discipline says to de-risk or avoid non-eligible themes rather than chase momentum rank.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend but gate fails — no confirmed absolute uptrend
theses.dissent: AI Compute is the only theme with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and is uncrowded (z=-0.66), which in a trending sub-market could be an early-stage theme before eligibility triggers—avoiding it risks missing an early move if the gate flips.

falsifier.text: AI Compute & Optics becomes eligible=true and its breadth expands above 0.30 on the next two consecutive detector snapshots
